identity.method: Identical 100000 create-one-variable / restore-empty iterations, followed by cloning and unchanged scope/alias/type-flag cases. Current probe adds private retired-range storage and TermNode sizeof counters.
identity.limit: Only identity-array and retired-range payload capacities measured; allocator overhead and node/trail/store buffers are excluded. Live-table capacity follows peak live occupancy; reserved range capacity follows peak live occupancy plus range fragmentation. Arbitrarily sparse retirement may still grow with the number of intervals. No RSS or universally bounded-history claim.

list.method: Build typed list using three APP nodes per cons (cons type item tail), typed nil=(nil type). Peeling allocates fresh x/xs, unifies cons type x xs with current list, then continues with dereferenced xs; no backtrack/restore until destruction.
list.measurement: Baseline and current use same list_probe.c and -O2 compile. One bounded run per size, monotonic wall clock excludes construction/destruction. No affinity, warm-up, statistical inference or cross-engine comparison. Retained node counts are deterministic.
list.limit: Fast path covers immutable pure rigid constructor trees only. Raw wire import and nonground/higher-order traversals retain depth limits; exporting many local variables each pointing into a long list can still expand overlapping tails quadratically.

verification.result: All 20 term test groups pass under ASan/UBSan/leak detection, with 31 allocation-failure paths. test/v1/ho_term.sh additionally passed 214 native/BETA HOPU differential cases. test/v1/higher_native.sh passed snapshot/native cases; root owns final broader regression runs.
verification.review: Independent F3 and F4 read-only reviews found no blocker. F5 variable reuse remains unchanged; scope-dependency, visible alias and mixed-type-flag counterexamples preserved.

metadata_interning.description: F6 runtime metadata identity membership lookup, original repeated scan vs cached Set
metadata_interning.method: Three paired sequential before/after samples per symbol count; already-present type constructors, empty type/query environments; force input map sizes and word-list length before timer, time forcing output symbol-map size. Old function copied verbatim, current function imported. No native search. Small diagnostic sample, not an end-to-end benchmark.
metadata_interning.source:
module Main where

import Control.Exception (evaluate)
import Control.Monad (forM_)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import Hol.BETA.Constant
import Hol.BETA.Header
import Hol.BETA.TermNode (LogicVar)
import Hol.V1.FullBytecode
import qualified Data.IntMap.Strict as IntMap
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Text.Printf (printf)

oldMetadata :: KindEnv -> TypeEnv -> Map.Map LogicVar (MonoType Int) -> FullProgram -> FullProgram
oldMetadata kinds types variables program = enriched { fullKindEnv = kinds, fullTypeEnv = types, fullQueryTypes = variables } where
    wanted = map (ConstantSymbol . TC) (Map.keys kinds) ++ map (ConstantSymbol . DC) (Map.keys types)
    symbols = foldl addSymbol (fullSymbols program) wanted
    addSymbol current symbol
        | any ((== symbolIdentity symbol) . symbolIdentity) (IntMap.elems current) = current
        | otherwise = IntMap.insert (IntMap.size current) symbol current
    enriched = case fullSections (fullWords program) of
        Right ([magic, version, terms, _, facts, slots, root, metadata], slotRows, _, termRows, factRows, payload) -> program
            { fullSymbols = symbols
            , fullWords = [magic, version, terms, fromIntegral (IntMap.size symbols), facts, slots, root, metadata] ++ concat slotRows ++ map (fromIntegral . symbolRole) (IntMap.elems symbols) ++ concat termRows ++ concat factRows ++ payload
            }
        _ -> program

main :: IO ()
main = forM_ [400, 800] $ \count -> forM_ [1 :: Int .. 3] $ \sample -> forM_ [("before", oldMetadata), ("after", withRuntimeMetadata)] $ \(label, enrich) -> do
    let names = [TC_Named (show sample ++ "_type_" ++ show index) | index <- [1 .. count]]
        kinds = Map.fromList [(name, Star) | name <- names]
        symbols = IntMap.fromList (zip [0 ..] (map ConstantSymbol ([DC (DC_LO LO_true), DC DC_Succ] ++ map TC names)))
        words = [1213156401,2,1,fromIntegral count+2,0,0,0,0] ++ [3,21] ++ replicate count 0 ++ [1,0,0,0,0,-1]
        program = FullProgram words symbols [] IntMap.empty Map.empty Map.empty Map.empty
    _ <- evaluate (Map.size kinds + IntMap.size symbols + length words)
    start <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    result <- evaluate (IntMap.size (fullSymbols (enrich kinds Map.empty Map.empty program)))
    end <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    printf "%s count=%d sample=%d symbols=%d milliseconds=%.6f\n" label count sample result (fromIntegral (end-start) / 1000000 :: Double)

predicate_index.method: Instrument the original and modified higher_machine.c on the same native fixtures. facts-512 has 512 unrelated global facts before one matching fact. localfacts-64 has 64 unrelated local hypotheses before one matching fact. Counters measure descriptors examined, facts instantiated and choices pushed; no wall-clock claim.

limits: The identity probe measures backing-array payload capacities, not process RSS; sparse retired intervals and observed host identities may still accumulate.
Ground list probes use native immutable constructor terms. They do not establish linear end-to-end append performance or remove raw import and nonground recursion limits.
All host service requests still include complete state. Compact pending-frame metadata preserves repeated declarations and their order.
Per-query source compilation remains; the metadata result measures identity lookup only.
